$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';
function Get-RepxScript([string]$Path){
  $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
  $m = [regex]::Match($text, 'string resourceString = (?<expr>(?:"[^"]*"\s*\+\s*)*"[^"]*")\s*;')
  if(-not $m.Success){ throw "resourceString not found: $Path" }
  $parts = [regex]::Matches($m.Groups['expr'].Value, '"([^"]*)"') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }
  $bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String(($parts -join ''))
  $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(,$bytes)
  $rr = New-Object System.Resources.ResourceReader($ms)
  foreach($entry in $rr){ if($entry.Key -eq '$this.ScriptsSource'){ return [string]$entry.Value } }
  throw "ScriptsSource not found: $Path"
}
